purpose: Descriptive audit of selected locator on internal training monitor only; original vs filled predicted-mask channel, RGB/targets unchanged. No new fitting, identity validation/test inference, threshold search or promotion.
limits: Monitor reused for checkpoint selection. Targets are proxies derived from iris annotation. Mask topology measured at64x64 is not native fallback classification. Filling holes is a channel intervention, NOT an ocular occlusion.
statistics: All879 retained; center error ROI normalized Euclidean, radius absolute normalized error; report original/filled mask and concentric baseline, per-person means and quantiles; native annotation ellipticity and512-angle inner/outer containment, no score-based selection.
